G1_unambiguity.justification: The certificate condition unambiguously means that no two-unit assignment can separate every volatile pair among the three materials.

G2_completeness.justification: The statement supplies all input bounds, guarantees existence, output ordering and tie-breaking rules, and the relevant edge condition.

G3_faithfulness.justification: For three vertices, inability to properly assign them to two units is equivalent to all three pairs being conflicts, so the required output is exactly the same as in the original.

G4_naturalness.justification: The storage-unit scenario is coherent and readable, though phrases such as “minimal certificate of this instability” are somewhat contrived.
